newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 30.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

The School Curriculum and Assessment Authority's report on the moral values that should be taught to children in schools says family life is the bedrock of a caring society, but does not say marriage is essential.
GAS PRICE WAR STARTS IN THE SOUTH EAST

Calortex, one of British Gas' main rivals, offered households in the South East savings of roughly 70 stg annually, following the announcement by Ofgas that competition would be introduced in Kent and Sussex from 7 March next year.
FINSBURY FLOATS A 62 MILLION STG HEDGE-FUND FIRST

Finsbury International Hedge Investment Company, Britain's first quoted hedge fund investment vehicle, will come to the stock market next month through an institutional placing by SBC Warburg and Rea Brothers.
The dollar was close to a one-month low yesterday, following a rise by the Deutschmark.
HK SNAPS UP REGALIAN'S LONDON FLATS

Regalian Properties has sold 30 million stg worth of London flats to buyers in Hong Kong and Singapore, 20 million stg of which were sold to Hong Kong buyers. Jovy Wong, a director at Regalian Hong Kong, put this down to an upturn in the Hong Kong economy and an increasing divestment of assets out of the colony in the run-up to the handover to mainland China.
